notes.title: Destruction Dummies Update 1.6a
notes.content: Small update fixing robogirl not clearing properly upon usage of "Clear All"

notes.title: Destruction Dummies Update Version 1.6
notes.content:
Changed Robot Dummy Aesthetic
Added "Gore" Option to "Settings" Menu - Enable / Disable

notes.title: Destruction Dummies Version 1.4a Update
notes.content:
Added "Clear All" button to menu that clears scene of all spawned NPCs, items etc
Added Delete objects / NPCs via keyboard "Delete" Key
Added Confirmation prompts to "Clear All" and "Quit"
Added "Escape" keyboard key usage to deselect NPCs
Added Q / E keyboard key usage to raise / lower camera position
Added Initial Help control scheme window

notes.title: Destruction Dummies - Version 1.4 Update
notes.content:
Fixed Hammer Vehicle/Static, Swinging Blade Vehicle/Static weapon speeds to restrict max speed - will help with inconsistent collisions 
Fixed "Settings" Menu:
Depth of Field - On / Off
Brightness Scale
Contrast Scale
Saturation Scale
Bloom - On/Off
Chromatic Aberration - On/Off
Screen Space Reflections - On/Off
Ambient Occlusion - On/Off
Resolution
Full screen / Windowed Modes

notes.title: Destruction Dummies Version 1.2a - Small update
notes.content:
Small update:

Expanded "Bulldozer" and "Killdozer" mechanics.
Hold "Left Ctrl" to stop vehicle rotation
Hold "Q" to lower mechanical arm
Hold "E" to raise mechanical arm

notes.title: Update Version 1.2 - Destruction Dummies
notes.content:
V1.2:


Fixed FPS melee weapons damage zones
Added skeleton damage indicator GUI to NPC menu
Added active vs On Click bomb variants to quick spawner drop menu
Added scrolling ticker of interaction statistics (Deaths, limbs destroyed etc) to menu screen
NPCs if spawned in quick succession will now alternate spawn positions to minimise exploding on spawn
Added Interactivity to Blender: Lid open / close on click, Blade on / off on click of respective buttons. 
Upgraded blender gore for more visceral experience.
Added "Killdozer" vehicle to Vehicles Menu

notes.title: Destruction Dummies Update V1.1
notes.content:
Expanded "beach" theme
Fixed "Space" theme
Changed post process
Added contextual menu to Tornado Object - added "npc only", "force gravity", "max items", "suction", "range", "mute", "ejection collider"
Added dog fight mode
Added spawnable skeleton
Added corrected npc specific skeletons
Fixed Tornado particle glitch
Changed Tornado audio during pause
Added "Delete" to NPC Menu
Added delete sound
Added Volcano to "Beach" theme
